headline.label: 3.08× TypeScript execution time
headline.explanation: Geometric mean of 45 same-point warmed execution-time ratios across 23 source files. 1× is parity; lower is better.

aggregation.note: Every one of the 45 benchmark points gets equal weight. A source may contribute multiple inputs; equal-source weighting would give 4.15×. The corpus is maintained and informed development; it does not describe all Bend programs.

latest.groupingNote: programs groups the45 points by the23 catalog benchmark families and uses a geometric mean within each. Family groups and exact-source groups are distinct; the headline remains equal point.

scopeNotes: Latest repository campaigns46/47 retain installed Phase45 worker23; no newer representative full45 result was claimed in those reports at the pinned source head.
Historical15-case Phase36 data must not be joined to full45 averages as the suite expanded in Phase37.
Latest32 medians lower and13 higher than previous release;2 points beat TypeScript. Descriptive results, not statistical significance claims.
Largest remaining ratios occur on tiny/generic paths: morning60.61×, zero-work scalar60.12×, generic row58.18×, Map/Set56.86×, RLE56.41×. Keep these in breakdown.
historyNotes: Descriptive snapshot index, not a workload-population estimate or statistically established improvement between historical runs.
No multiplication of incremental improvements; every value is computed directly against same-run pinned TypeScript.
P37/P39/P40 use historical/variation 1000ms warmup 300ms sample blocks and new application 600ms warmup 250ms blocks; later full-suite batches use1000ms warmup 300ms blocks.
P40 selects42 exact-byte reused comparisons and3 fresh checked06 raytrace comparisons.
P41 value is freshly measured as baseline in P42 report; its original phase report covers only6 inputs.
